titulo_es: Go by transport: journey and custom
intro: Ехать usually describes a vehicle trip in a direction; ездить, regular, repeated or in different directions.

bloques.titulo: Ехать usually describes a vehicle trip in a direction; ездить, regular, repeated or in different directions.
texto: Ехать usually describes a vehicle trip in a direction; ездить, regular, repeated or in different directions.
The means of transport can be indicated with на + acusativa: ехать на автобусе, на поезде.
